The café is expected to vacate its longtime home at 4700 N. Central Ave during Q4 2026 as part of a relocation to the Biltmore neighborhood. The old space had been home to the restaurant for a long time and the move replaces Scramble, which closed there in September 2025.

data.status: expected to relocate later this year
data.short_description: Fà-me Café is a locally owned breakfast and lunch restaurant founded by Maria and Ivan O'Farrill. The café is expected to open a 3,600-square-foot ground-floor space at 24th at Camelback office complex at 2375 E. Camelback Road during Q4 2026. The new location replaces Scramble, which closed there in September 2025.

Matilde is an elevated coastal Mexican restaurant concept from Next Level Brands, located just off the Riverwalk in Downtown Tampa. The restaurant will open at the Arts and Entertainment Residences at 300 W Tyler St, with a target opening of Spring 2027. The concept was announced by Jeff Gigante, Founder of Next Level Brands, and will join tenants including JetSet Pilates and Bagel Nook.

data.status: expected to launch in late June/early July
data.short_description: 4T's Eatery is a restaurant run by four family members — Torrey, Timothy, Tiana, and Timari — serving waffles and chicken-and-waffle combinations. The new restaurant is opening at a larger, upgraded space at 6050 Moncrief Road, expected to launch in late June/early July. The concept evolved from Phoenix Eatery, which launched on Phoenix Avenue in 2023 and had a successful but brief run.

Norikawa is a new Japanese restaurant concept from Pearl Hospitality Group (part of Bento Group), comparable to their existing Tinseltown restaurant Norikase. Plans in permit review show a two-floor space at the One Riverside development on the Downtown Northbank in Brooklyn, featuring indoor/outdoor bar and dining on the first floor and a bar, lounge, omakase counter, and DJ booth on the second. The concept, like Norikase, will offer an omakase dining experience with a multicourse tasting menu.

data.status: preparing to launch OH's Wine Salon later this summer
data.short_description: OH's Wine Salon is a wine and small plates concept from Virginia vintners Ana Hirsbrunner and Waldemar Ortiz, the duo behind OH's Vineyard, featuring a 2,200 sq ft space with seating for 45 and an outdoor patio. The salon is preparing to open later this summer at 35246 Leesburg Pike, Suite 190, offering wines from OH's Vineyard and other Virginia producers alongside a Nuevo Latino-inspired small plates menu. Ortiz described the opening as "a dream come true" as a chef and winemaker.

data.status: working to open by the end of the month
data.short_description: O'Mara Irish Pub is a veteran- and woman-owned Irish pub offering beer, wine, pub fare, and live music, with seating for about 100 guests. The pub is opening at 939 Edgewood Ave S in Murray Hill and is working to open by the end of the month. Co-owner Amy Tomb described a copper epoxy bar, green décor, and plans for Irish food items and open-mic jam nights once open.

data.status: slated to open its second location
data.short_description: La Neta is a fast-casual taquería from local restaurateur Allan Rodríguez, known for traditional Mexican flavors including tacos, burritos, and quesadillas. A document shared on the Downtown Boston Facebook page indicates a second location is slated to open at 100 City Hall Plaza in downtown Boston. The new space will share a footprint with a brand-new concept called Churrería 52, also from Rodríguez.

Churrería 52 is a new concept from restaurateur Allan Rodríguez specializing in churros in inventive forms and flavors. An Instagram story from La Neta suggests the new space at 100 City Hall Plaza will share a footprint with Churrería 52. Early previews showcase varieties including sprinkle-coated churros, churros topped with dulce de leche, and chocolate-dipped versions.

data.status: expanding its location to include a restaurant
data.short_description: Arcade Time Entertainment is an award-winning arcade at The Mall at Wellington Green offering modern and retro arcade games, VR, duckpin bowling, and interactive darts. The venue is expanding to include a food menu featuring items such as filet mignon, chicken and waffles, and sirloin steak, plus beer, wine, and cocktails. Founder and CEO Jonathan Demare shared that the company is in rapid expansion mode with locations planned in Tennessee, Ohio, Las Vegas, Texas, and additional South Florida arcades.

data.status: hoping to be open by July 1 at the latest
data.short_description: Johnson's Coffee Co. is a mobile coffee and matcha trailer serving Orlando that has operated for about nine months, specializing in espresso drinks at events. The brand is launching its first permanent brick-and-mortar café at 1480 E Michigan Street, with owner Sean Johnson stating they're hoping to open by July 1 at the latest. The new space will expand the menu to include drip coffee, avocado toast, bagels, sourdoughs, and more pastries.

data.status: looking to open in the middle or at the end of July
data.short_description: Bosu Latin Asian Fusion is the first standalone restaurant from the Bosu Asian Fusion Bistro team, blending Puerto Rican, Japanese-Peruvian, and Chinese cuisines with a focus on sushi. Co-owner Jose Martin stated they're looking to open at 231 Broadway Ave in Downtown Kissimmee in mid to late July. The restaurant will feature an open kitchen where guests can watch the chef and sushi chef at work.

data.status: new restaurant opening in the space
data.short_description: Mama Oi is a Vietnamese kitchen concept from Mama Oi Vietnamese Kitchen LLC, appearing to be run by the Nguyen family who previously operated Papasan's and Mamasan's at the same address. Plan review documents confirm a new restaurant called Mama Oi is opening at 400 N Cocoa Blvd, with Bich Nguyen confirming the news but noting it was too early to share additional details. The building has previously been home to Mamasan's, Papasan's, and Pho Lam's over the years.

Frutella is a Colombian-inspired restaurant serving items like Pandebono Cake, Pandebono Waffles, pasteles de guayaba, and arepas, with existing locations in Kissimmee and Riverview. Plan review documents submitted by Frutella Orlando LLC show a new location opening at 1333 Florida Mall Ave in the space formerly occupied by Could 07 Smoke Shop. Co-owner Nathalie Alvarez was not immediately available for comment at time of publication.

data.short_description: Hôtel du Fjord is a 34-room hotel in downtown Chicoutimi that has been sold to a new ownership group behind Auberge Le Parasol. The article covers a change of ownership and planned repositioning, not an opening, closing, or remodel event. The new owners plan future renovations and a mixed-use development, but no qualifying event has been confirmed or dated.

data.status: expected by the end of the month
data.short_description: Pienezza Pizza is a pizza restaurant currently operating at 3236 N John Young Pkwy serving handcrafted New York-style and Sicilian pizzas. A representative confirmed to What Now that a second location at 422 Terry Ave in Orlando is expected to open by end of the month. The menu at the new location will include classic round and square/Sicilian pizzas, wings, sandwiches, and pasta dishes.

Cipresso is the long-standing Italian restaurant at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood. The restaurant's own website states it will close permanently on June 13, with the casino having joined forces with Major Food Group to bring new and exclusive dining experiences. A new unnamed Major Food Group concept is expected to open in its place in Fall 2026.

An unnamed dining concept from Major Food Group is set to debut at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood, replacing Cipresso. Details about the name and concept have not been released, though there is speculation it may be one of Major Food Group's Italian concepts. Major Food Group operates more than 40 restaurants and hospitality venues globally, with known concepts including Carbone, Sadelle's, and Dirty French.

data.status: expected to open between mid and late August
data.short_description: Turquoise Wine Bar is a franchise wine bar concept founded by Jen Sinconis and Laura Hernandez, combining curated boutique wine programs, small plates, live entertainment, and member experiences. State licensing records and franchise owner Tim Wagenseller confirm the opening at 14462 W. Elm Street, Suite 113, in Surprise City Center between mid and late August. The location will offer rotating small-lot wine flights, small plates including flatbreads and charcuterie, and live music on weekends, with no televisions on premise.

data.status: targeting an opening ahead of the upcoming college football season
data.short_description: Atomic Wings is a Buffalo-inspired chicken wing chain serving wings, tenders, sandwiches, and sauces. The franchise is planning its first Ohio location at 2112 N. High St. in Columbus, targeting an opening before the college football season, though the project is currently in the design and planning stages. The restaurant will serve 100% halal, fresh never-frozen chicken with approximately 15 sauces, and is located in Schiff Real Estate Co.'s University Gateway North building.

data.status: aiming for a July opening date
data.short_description: Osteria Gilberto is a new Italian restaurant concept coming to the Lincoln Park neighborhood of Chicago. Owner Sergio Barbone submitted a liquor license application for the corner of W Webster Avenue and N Magnolia Avenue, with a target July opening. Barbone also owns Bakehouse Chicago, a bakery with locations in Lakeview, Roscoe Village, and Southport.

Le Petit Comptoir Wine & Cheese is a wine-and-cheese concept offering small plates, charcuterie boards, grilled cheeses, and zero-proof options in a cozy setting. Owner Alex Lewis is currently hiring ahead of a tentative July 2026 opening beside Marblehead House of Pizza at 1 Atlantic Ave in Marblehead. The concept has been building community engagement through weekly wine-and-cheese tastings, pairing events, and educational classes ahead of its grand opening.

The Laureate is a new boutique hotel being developed by Tina McCarthy in partnership with Chad Ingram and Rob Johnston, incorporating the historic Farmers and Merchants Bank Building at 167 Laurens St. in downtown Aiken. The project will break ground in fall 2026 and will include an 84-room four-story new build with a lobby bar and garden courtyard, plus a historic renovation housing a restaurant, bar, meeting rooms, and fitness space. The development is described as a "revitalization and cornerstone of downtown Aiken," with historic preservation a stated priority including retention of original safes, arches, and terrazzo floors.
